newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Union Bank to launch US$75 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Union Bank to launch US$75 mln FRCD.

text.p: Pre-marketing of Union Bank of the Philippines $75 million floating rate certificates of deposit issue has begun, bankers said Monday.
The issue is expected to be formally launched into general syndication on November 4.
The certificates carry a maturity of five years with put and a call options in year three. They will pay a coupon of 85 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers committing US$5 million or more is 93 basis points
Arrangers are Merrill Lynch, Standard Chartered Investment Banking, LTCB Asia and Dresdner South East Asia.
